status: Declared before fitting this hypothesis; data previously inspected, development evidence only.
formula: common(x) + a*L(x) + b*W(x) versus common(x) + max(a*L(x),b*W(x))
L: K/(32*q)/64: per-CTA mainloop depth proxy, not measured isolated latency
W: 2*M*K*ceil(N/(128*g))/2^20: total logical A reads per GEMM, not physical HBM/NVLink bytes
scope: Shared fused coefficients, unchanged four host models. Per-execution statistical estimates under the old frozen policy. Not a hardware roofline.
solver: Sort W/L training ratios, enumerate all <= rows+1 switch intervals. In each interval a/b lies in a 2D cone, parameterize nonnegative extreme rays and solve convex nonnegative quadratic. Fixed original normalized-coefficient ridge=1e-6 across intervals. Compare feasible objectives globally; no initial guesses or stochastic optimizer.
validation: branch and crossover stability across folds
focus: M64/K4096/N2048 with all M64 left out
promotion: No automatic compiler change even if development thresholds pass. Report all variants and regressions; no independent test set available.
